scenes.heading: Ask for a higher commission once you've proven sales

sents.d: Ask for a higher commission once you've proven sales
Once you've driven steady sales for a program, it's worth asking for a better rate.
Programs want to keep partners who deliver customers.
A higher rate on the same traffic means more commission with no extra content.
Pull your recent clicks, sales and conversion rate.
Email your affiliate manager with those numbers and politely ask what custom rate they can offer.

take: Proven sales earn you the right to ask for a better rate.
